Summary: Implements the unsigning process for a signed value, handling potential BadSignature exceptions.

Description: Created to handle the unsigning of signed values, this class ensures that any BadSignature exceptions are properly managed by setting the payload to None and re-raising the exception. It is used by the system to ensure data integrity during the unsigning process.
